---
title: "Apply"
description: "How to apply for a Data Insight scholarship."
---

The program is open only to people who receive a Data Insight scholarship or fellowship. There is no fee to apply.

## Before you apply

Read the [program details](program.qmd) and make sure you can commit about 20 hours a week for six or twelve months.

## Application

The application form will be linked here when the next cohort opens.
